analyst.summary: Waaree Energies delivered another strong year (FY26 revenue +84%, PAT doubled) on the back of rapid capacity scale-up in modules, cells and EPC, and management is guiding a further 18-30% EBITDA increase for FY27 backed by a healthy ~Rs 53,000cr order book. Valuation has cooled to a reasonable ~22x earnings after a roughly 27% pullback from the 52-week high. The main new overhang is a June-2026 US Customs finding that Waaree evaded anti-dumping duties on certain past shipments (potential cash deposits up to ~271% on the flagged volumes), which Waaree disputes; alongside a cash-conversion dip this year (inventory build outpacing profit growth), this is worth watching over the next couple of quarters even though the core business remains high-quality and reasonably valued. Recommendation: Hold.
